lines: The Central Bank limit for a first-time buyer is 4 times gross income: €360,000 on €90,000. Lenders decide within it, and may lend above it only under the 15% allowance.
For a €350,000 home: a €315,000 mortgage (90% of the price) and a €35,000 deposit.
Needed at the keys: €41,500 (the deposit, €3,500 stamp duty and about €3,000 for legal fees and a survey).
At €800 a month from €25,000, that is saved around August 2028, before interest: by November 2028, the date given.
